Throughput: steady 120 reqs/minute with spikes to 350 rpm during marketing events. Cost-sensitive but prefers predictable monthly spend. Wants same API contract across hosted -> dedicated transition. pricing_discussion: Current ask: Dedicated reserved capacity with 12-month commit. Action: recommend Dedicated for steady-state traffic and using Optimize suggestions for batching and quantization to hit ARR target.
